newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan electronics shares down in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan electronics shares down in late trade.

text.p: Shares in Taiwan's electronic firms fell in late Wednesday trading on profit-taking following sharp November gains, brokers said.
With 20 minutes left, recently listed "king share" Asustek plunged by the daily seven percent limit to T$306. The king share is that with the highest price stock in the market.
Likewise, newcomer Inventec Corp was down T$10 or 5.68 percent to T$166.
Both Asustek and Inventec were listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange in early November and had soared for several sessions in what brokers called a honeymoon rally.
The entire electronic sector was weak and was 0.40 percent lower shortly before the close.
"The market has said that when Asustek and Inventec finish their honeymoon, it's time for electronics to consolidate," said Alex Yang of National Securities.
